inputs_used: content-system/seo/link-map.csv (grep: trending, celebrity, ring, engaged, proposal)

payload.title: 25 Most Iconic Celebrity Engagement Rings
payload.audience: Couples in their 30s, affluent, interested in destination weddings and luxury celebrations, AUD 150k+ budget
payload.reader: A design-literate couple in their mid 30s, about to propose or newly engaged, who have saved photos of famous rings and want to know what each one actually is (cut, setting, style) and whether that look would suit the person who will wear it every day, including on the flight to and the week of a wedding abroad.
payload.goal: Click through to the destinations hub to start picturing where the wedding could happen (Wedded Concierge at /wonderland-concierge as the secondary CTA).
payload.angle: Page-one roundups lead with carat counts and dollar valuations and stop at the photo; this one treats each of 25 widely documented rings as a style lesson. Every entry names the look in plain words (cut, setting, style family), gives the one or two sourced facts that made it iconic, says who that look suits, and ends with a 'Get the look' line linking to our engagement ring styles guide, with no prices, no valuations and no gossip. The reader leaves with a shortlist of styles, not a list of price tags.
must_include: Short intro: how to read the list (each ring decoded into a style, who it suits and a 'Get the look' link to /style-advice/engagement-ring-styles); state that details are as reported by the cited sources and carats are given only as 'reported as about X carats' where sourced

Fact-check batch A, historic and royal (11): 1 Queen Victoria (serpent ring with emerald from Prince Albert; vintage, coloured stone); 2 Queen Elizabeth II (diamond solitaire with smaller side diamonds, reported as made from stones of Prince Philip's mother's tiara; heirloom solitaire); 3 Grace Kelly (emerald-cut diamond solitaire, reported as Cartier; solitaire); 4 Audrey Hepburn (eternity-style band from Mel Ferrer; eternity); 5 Jacqueline Kennedy (diamond and emerald side by side, reported as Van Cleef & Arpels; toi et moi); 6 Diana, Princess of Wales, now worn by Catherine, Princess of Wales (oval sapphire with diamond surround, reported as Garrard; halo, coloured stone); 7 Sophie, Duchess of Edinburgh (oval diamond flanked by heart-shaped diamonds; three-stone); 8 Queen Mary of Denmark (emerald-cut diamond with ruby baguettes, reported as echoing the Danish flag colours; three-stone, coloured accents; note Mary is Australian-born, framed as a fact only); 9 Meghan, Duchess of Sussex (centre diamond reported as from Botswana with two side diamonds from Diana's collection; three-stone); 10 Princess Eugenie (padparadscha sapphire with diamond surround; halo, coloured stone); 11 Princess Beatrice (diamond ring reported as by Shaun Leane with art deco-style detailing; art deco)

Fact-check batch B, modern (14): 12 Beyonce (emerald-cut diamond, reported as Lorraine Schwartz; solitaire); 13 Amal Clooney (emerald-cut diamond with tapered side stones; three-stone or side-stone); 14 Blake Lively (pink oval diamond, reported as Lorraine Schwartz; coloured diamond); 15 Hailey Bieber (oval diamond solitaire; solitaire); 16 Emma Stone (pearl centre with diamond surround, reported as Kataoka; alternative stone, cluster); 17 Priyanka Chopra Jonas (cushion-cut diamond, reported as Tiffany & Co.; solitaire); 18 Serena Williams (cushion-cut diamond, reported as Lorraine Schwartz; solitaire); 19 Simone Biles (oval diamond; solitaire or halo per source); 20 Selena Gomez (marquise-cut diamond on a slim band; fancy shape solitaire); 21 Lady Gaga (rose-cut diamond; vintage-inspired); 22 Sofia Richie Grainge (emerald-cut diamond; solitaire); 23 Taylor Swift (elongated cushion old mine cut diamond in yellow gold, reported as by Kindred Lubeck of Artifex Fine Jewelry; vintage-inspired); 24 Zendaya (large diamond, reported as Jessica McCormack; style label to be confirmed by the fact-checker, east-west if sources support it); 25 Miranda Kerr (round diamond from Evan Spiegel; solitaire; Australian reader hook)

Fact-checker substitutes if any ring above cannot be sourced to two reputable outlets: Hailee Steinfeld, Queen Maxima of the Netherlands, Princess Charlene of Monaco, Jennifer Lawrence. Keep the style mix balanced when swapping.

Every entry: the couple and engagement year, one or two sourced ring facts (cut, stone, setting, maker only as an attributed fact), why it became iconic in one line, a 'suits you if' line, and a 'Get the look' line linking to /style-advice/engagement-ring-styles (anchor naming the style)

A short 'what these rings teach us' section grouping the 25 by style family (solitaire, three-stone, toi et moi, halo, coloured stone, vintage and art deco, eternity, fancy shapes) as a scannable table

A brief section on wearing and photographing a statement ring at a destination wedding (sun, salt water, long-haul flights, ceremony close-ups), general advice only, linking /style-advice/engagement-ring-setting-for-active-lifestyle
FAQ (3 to 5): e.g. most famous engagement ring, why royals favour coloured stones, how to get a celebrity ring look in your own style; answers sourced or general, no prices

Internal links: /style-advice/engagement-ring-styles (every entry), /style-advice/engagement-ring-setting-for-active-lifestyle, /2026-engagement-ring-trends-amaree-jewellery, /expert-advice/how-much-should-you-spend-on-an-engagement-ring, /expert-advice/proposal-ideas, /the-top-proposal-destinations-in-italy, /top-celebrity-destination-weddings-of-all-time, /destinations (primary CTA), /wonderland-concierge (secondary CTA), UTM-tagged per services.md
Source rule for every ring fact: URL and date from reputable news, Vogue, Harper's Bazaar, official royal or palace statements, or auction houses; anything unsourced is left out rather than marked
avoid: Any prices, valuations, 'worth' figures or price comparisons for rings, stones or weddings
Carat weights stated as fact; only 'reported as about X carats' with a source, and omit if unsourced
Designer or house names as endorsements, links or recommendations; attributed facts only
Gossip, divorce or separation speculation, relationship claims beyond the engagement facts, and couples whose story is mainly scandal
Celebrity photos unless licensed by the team through an editorial agency; never AI images of real people or their rings; placeholders with shot briefs instead
Copying wording, structure or images from competitor roundups, including Easy Weddings
Invented statistics or 'X% of couples now choose' claims
Gendered assumptions about who proposes or wears the ring
Business details not in brand-facts.md (fees, a named Advisor, Wedded Privileges specifics are deferred)
Em dashes and US spelling (jewellery, colour, travelling)
payload.cannibalisation_check: None found targeting 'celebrity engagement rings'. Nearest: /style-advice/engagement-ring-styles (sister draft; owns style definitions and suitability, this post links into it from every entry rather than repeating), /2026-engagement-ring-trends-amaree-jewellery (dated trends), /trending/sabrina-barta-is-engaged-and-her-46-carat-ring-is-a-two-in-one-masterpiece and /trending/king-woolzs-lake-como-proposal-had-a-unique-ring (single news items, not a roundup), /trending/why-the-engagement-ring-upgrade-is-becoming-a-new-marriage-milestone (ring upgrades), and /top-celebrity-destination-weddings-of-all-time plus /our-favorite-celebrity-destination-weddings (weddings, not rings). No overlap on the head keyword; this post is the evergreen celebrity ring roundup.

checks.check: All 25 rings named in must_include in two fact-check batches (11 historic and royal, 14 modern) with substitutes

checks.check: Exactly 4 one-sentence takeaways, no prices, designer names as attributed facts only, respectful tone

open_questions.question: Confirm SERP coverage (do top results include royal rings, recent 2025 engagements such as Taylor Swift and Zendaya?), suggest secondaries such as 'famous engagement rings' and 'royal engagement rings', and recommend regional_scope.

Verify each ring's cut, stone, setting, maker and engagement year from two reputable sources with URL and date; confirm the style label for Zendaya (east-west or other), Simone Biles and Lady Gaga; swap in a substitute where a ring cannot be sourced.
No celebrity photos unless the team licenses them through an editorial agency; plan placeholders with shot briefs (style-led product or detail shots that are not of the celebrity rings).

assumptions: Mapped the person's 'Pillar' content type to schema value 'inspiration' (a curated roundup of famous rings) rather than 'comparison' used by the sister styles guide.
'Rings and Jewellery' is the person's cluster name and is not yet a category in the link map; 'Trends & Celebrity' and 'Proposals & Rings' are existing link-map categories.
Ring details in must_include are as widely reported and are research targets, not verified facts; the fact-checker confirms or drops each one.
Primary persona planner_couple is the closest fit; persona cards are provisional and uncalibrated.
regional_scope starts as global because celebrity rings are an international topic; Queen Mary of Denmark and Miranda Kerr give Australian readers a hook.
Elizabeth Taylor, Wallis Simpson, Kim Kardashian, Jennifer Lopez and similar were left out because their ring stories are tied to scandal or repeated relationship coverage.
